toegepas.voor: Van jou eie werk sien 'n mens
toegepas.na: In jou eie werk sien jy
toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson addresses the learner as 'jy' throughout; switching to 'n mens' here is jarring, and 'In jou eie werk' is the more natural preposition with 'sien'.
toegepas.fout: The sentence mixes 'jou eie werk' with ''n mens', switching person mid-sentence in a lesson that addresses the learner as 'jy'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: One consistent 'jy' reads naturally, 'in jou werk sien' means the same as 'van jou werk sien', and the protected 'nie altyd alles self nie' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: al werk en watter deel nog nie
toegepas.na: al werk en watter deel nog nie werk nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The elliptical 'nog nie' at the end of the sentence reads unfinished for a Grade 5 learner; completing the clause matches the wording used in the next block.
toegepas.fout: The elliptical ending 'watter deel nog nie.' reads unfinished for a Grade 5 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Completing the clause is clearer, matches the next block's wording and the definitions, and changes nothing in the meaning.

toegepas.voor: Albei soorte is terugvoering en albei
toegepas.na: Albei soorte is terugvoering, en albei
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Albei soorte is terugvoering' and 'albei kan vriendelik gesê word' are two full sentences, so the AWS comma is required.

toegepas.voor: vir jou en jy sê net mooi
toegepas.na: vir jou, en jy sê net "mooi"
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full sentences, and quotation marks show that 'mooi' is the word said, not 'you just say nicely'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses, and 'jy sê net mooi' can be read as 'you just speak nicely' rather than 'you only say the word mooi'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required and the quotation marks remove a real ambiguity without changing what is said.

toegepas.blok: Praat oor die werk en nie oor die mens nie
toegepas.voor: te klein vir die agterste banke
toegepas.na: te klein om van die agterste banke af te lees
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'te klein vir die agterste banke' is compressed and slightly wooden; spelling out 'to read from the back benches' keeps the meaning and reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'te klein vir die agterste banke' is compressed and wooden; benches do not read.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal says plainly what the original means, too small to read from the back, and adds no new fact.

toegepas.blok: Praat oor die werk en nie oor die mens nie
toegepas.voor: Die eerste manier sê sy plakkaat is sleg en hy kan nie mooi skryf nie
toegepas.na: Die eerste manier sê dat sy plakkaat sleg is en dat hy nie mooi kan skryf nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without 'dat' the second clause can be read as the narrator's own statement that he cannot write neatly; 'dat ... dat' makes both parts clearly what is said.
toegepas.fout: With main-clause word order after 'en', 'hy kan nie mooi skryf nie' can be read as the lesson's own statement about the boy rather than what the first way says.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'dat ... dat' makes both parts clearly the words of the first way, removing a real misreading without changing the content.

toegepas.blok: Praat oor die werk en nie oor die mens nie
toegepas.voor: Die tweede manier sê die letters onderaan is te klein
toegepas.na: Die tweede manier sê dat die letters onderaan te klein is
toegepas.rede_vinder: Keeps the reported-speech construction parallel with the sentence about the first way.
toegepas.fout: After change 7, the second way would no longer be parallel with the first, blurring the contrast the block draws.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Keeping the two reported statements in the same construction makes the comparison between the two ways easy to follow, with the meaning unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Praat oor die werk en nie oor die mens nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'die regte oomblik kies' is the idiomatic expression; 'die oomblik kies' alone sounds unfinished.
toegepas.fout: 'Kies ook die oomblik' is a broken form of the fixed expression 'die regte oomblik kies' and sounds unfinished.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal restores the natural Afrikaans expression and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.blok: Wanneer iemand vir jou terugvoering gee
toegepas.voor: 'n Maat sê vir jou wat nog nie reg is nie
toegepas.na: 'n Ander keer sê 'n maat vir jou wat nog nie reg is nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence starts a second situation after 'Soms ...'; a linking phrase makes the shift clear instead of reading as a flat statement of fact.
toegepas.fout: After 'Soms sê iemand ...', the bare ''n Maat sê vir jou ...' reads as a flat statement of fact rather than a second situation.
toegepas.rede_keurder: ''n Ander keer' marks the shift to the second situation, keeps the same person and action, and adds no fact.

na_skrywer.voor: en jy kon dit van agter lees
na_skrywer.na: en jy kan dit van agter af lees
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'van agter af' is the idiomatic form, and present 'kan' matches the present 'is' earlier in the same sentence.
na_skrywer.fout: 'van agter lees' lacks the 'af' of the fixed expression 'van agter af'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The idiom fix is right, but the proposal also changes 'kon' (you were able to read it, the concrete evidence) to 'kan', which moves the meaning, so the writer should fix only the idiom.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.blok: Wanneer woorde nie meer terugvoering is nie
na_skrywer.voor: Dit kan die grootmens by die huis wees
na_skrywer.na: Dit kan 'n grootmens by die huis wees
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'die grootmens by die huis' implies there is only one adult at home; the indefinite article fits the list that follows.
na_skrywer.fout: 'die grootmens by die huis' implies there is only one adult at home.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is real, but this sentence lists whom to tell in a safety instruction, so the writer owns the wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Praat oor die werk en nie oor die mens nie
vlae.teks: Die eerste manier sê sy plakkaat is sleg en hy kan nie mooi skryf nie.
vlae.rede: 'Die eerste manier' and 'Die tweede manier' refer to two ways of giving the feedback that are never introduced in the block; fixing it needs a sentence saying there are two ways, which is content, so the writer should decide.

vlae.teks: Die opskrif is groot en donker, en jy kon dit van agter lees.
vlae.rede: This sentence is meant as an example of what you could say to your friend, but nothing marks it as spoken words or as an example, so it reads like a narrator's statement; the writer should decide how to signal it.
